title: A relative global complete intersection is defined over a finitely generated subring of the base
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a relative global complete intersection over a ring is already defined over a finitely generated subring of that ring, in such a way that the smaller algebra is again a relative global complete intersection (statement lines 36943-36954). The proof descends the finitely many coefficients of the relations to the subring they generate, observes that the original algebra is the base change of the descended one, and verifies the two defining conditions over the smaller base using that the set of offending primes is finite (proof lines 36956-36981). Reducing the conditions to finitely many primes is what makes the descent work. H2.
